mapper.select: select inventory_id, stock_unit_code, material_code, storage_id, storage_code, zone_id, zone_code, inventory_qty, reserved_qty, reserved_order_no, unit, version, del_flag from wms_inventory where inventory_id = #{inventoryId} and del_flag = '0' for update

select s.storage_id, s.storage_code, s.zone_id, z.zone_code, s.status, s.lock_status, s.disable_status, s.del_flag from wms_storage s left join wms_warehouse_zone z on z.zone_id = s.zone_id where s.storage_id = #{storageId} and s.del_flag = '0'
select flow_id, idempotency_key, inventory_id, from_storage_code, to_storage_code, occurred_at from wms_inventory_flow where idempotency_key = #{idempotencyKey} for update
mapper.update: update wms_inventory set storage_id = #{storageId}, storage_code = #{storageCode}, zone_id = #{zoneId}, zone_code = #{zoneCode}, version = version + 1, update_by = #{actorId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, update_time = #{occurredAt} where inventory_id = #{inventoryId} and version = #{expectedVersion} and del_flag = '0'
mapper.insert: insert into wms_inventory_flow ( flow_id, flow_no, flow_type, inventory_id, stock_unit_code, material_code, material_batch, from_storage_code, to_storage_code, before_qty, change_qty, after_qty, source_order_type, source_order_no, source_order_line_id, idempotency_key, operator_id, occurred_at, create_time, remark ) values ( #{flowId}, #{flowNo}, #{flowType}, #{inventoryId}, #{stockUnitCode}, #{materialCode}, #{materialBatch,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{fromStorageCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{toStorageCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{beforeQty}, #{changeQty}, #{afterQty}, #{sourceOrderType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{sourceOrderNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{sourceOrderLineId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{idempotencyKey}, #{operatorId,jdbcType=BIGINT}, #{occurredAt}, #{createTime}, #{remark,jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
